text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today, I accompanied Matikanetannhauser 
for a photoshoot after she was chosen as 
the model for the academy's poster.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Hannyaka~, funnyaka~...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I was praying to my good luck charm 
so the photoshoot goes well!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
The charm on my ribbon is something 
Fuku-chan-senpai gave me~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And Matikanetannhauser told me all about 
the charm on her outfit—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! Machi-san! You're getting a brand 
new outfit?!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's the Fan Thanksgiving uniform! 
That's right! It's my new outfit!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"You were serving as the Demon General, 
right! In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I shall pray to Lady Shiraoki to grant 
Machi-san the power of certain victory!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If we do that, I'm sure you'll be a 
massive hit at the Fan Thanksgiving 
Festival~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Heeere I gooo!! Hannyaka~! Funnyaka~! With 
reverence and awe, I—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur in the Hallway
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh!! Shut up!! Why're you so damn loud 
this early in the morning?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: We got kicked out, didn't we...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No...! This must surely be a revelation 
from Lady Shiraoki!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It must be a sign that I need to step 
outside and borrow the power of various 
other gods as well!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right! No time like the present! Let's 
head straight to the shrine to pray!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: By-ar-ya~, dar-ar-ya~, God-god-phin!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Three Goddesses~! Please, lend me your 
strength~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Since we're asking for a favor, let's make 
an offering of thanks in advance!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Here I am! I brought cookies~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah! Why do we have to run 
the whole way~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It's to show the gods just how 
desperately we want our wish granted!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... This is the Shinme-kakeru 
place, isn't it~? Why go out of our way to 
come all the way here...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... This is a place where gods 
are said to dwell!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm borrowing power from the gods, I 
should at least make my wish up close!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hear my plea, hear my prayer~! Please lend 
your strength to O-Machi~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ Barely made curfew! But man, it was 
great to get so much help from everyone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my...? There seems to be some sort of 
power swirling around Machi-san..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Could it be that my power is leaking out?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: H-Huh? Where? Where from!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: I-I need to put it into something quickly—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I know! Let's put it into my charm! 
O-Machi-san, please gather all the power 
you can!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Understood! Hyah! Hyah!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur in the Hallway
text_block_list.text: Shut up!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...And that's how it went!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"So whenever I pray to this charm... 
somehow, courage wells up inside me!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it... Fuku-chan-senpai 
is, to me—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
She's always bright, always looking 
forward... Just like the ideal big sister 
I've always admired!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That senpai prayed for my success...! Then 
I've gotta live up to her expectations~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...thinking that makes me want to do my 
best!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Once I take the photos, I'll show 
them to you first!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'll aim for a miraculous shot that we can 
both be thrilled about~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, striking poses as if truly 
possessed by something, Matikanetannhauser 
successfully finished the photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Umm, so according to 
Fuku-chan-senpai—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
They say that praying in this direction 
today brings even greater good fortune!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hannyaka~, funnyaka~. ...Come on, together 
now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps praying together with her in the 
corner of the studio brought good luck, 
because the photo shoot was a resounding 
success.
